title: Open a popped car hood: push its hidden safety-catch lever aside, lift until the struts take over
instruction: The hood has been popped from inside. Open it fully.
context: Opening the hood starts every under-hood check, and the safety catch is the part drivers fumble: popped from inside, the hood rises only 3 cm and a hook under its front edge holds it. Fingers go into the gap to find the catch lever's tab and push it sideways; the hood is then lifted off the hook. Once the front edge is about 23 cm higher, the gas struts carry it to its stop.
setup: Origin: table top below the arm-base midpoint; x forward, y left (cm). Car front-end rig on the table: steel hood 140 x 101 x 2.5 cm, 14 kg, silver, hinged at its rear edge (x 135, 30 cm up), front edge at x 34.6, 16.7 cm up (popped 3 cm onto its safety hook). Black grille cross-member (front face x 39, top 12 cm up), striker loop in its central opening; fenders, engine, cowl. Catch lever: black tab 1.6 x 1.8 cm hanging under the hood 1.4 cm behind the front edge at y 0, about 14 cm up. Build list, anchoring and acceptance checks in README.
scoring: Score 0 if the hood, coming back down from a 10 cm lift (before it settles), sinks below 7 cm over its popped height with a gripper under its front 15 cm, above the cross-member top (fingers caught). Otherwise 0.25 the lever swung 19.5 deg (tab 1.5 cm aside), freeing the hook; 0.5 the front edge lifted 10 cm above its popped height; 1.0 hood at its full-open stop (within 1 deg of 50 deg) with every gripper point 15 cm from the hood, the hook and the cross-member at the end, all moving under 2 cm/s for 0.5 s.
reset_notes: Lower the hood until its safety hook catches the striker (front edge 3 cm up, popped), lever back on its rest stop.
fidelity: Body, cross-member and striker fixed; the bay under the hood is cut down to the table. Hood rigid on a revolute hinge; struts and pop spring are the hinge's joint drive, set each step to give the measured profile: 2 N m opening up to 2.6 deg (pop spring), about 6 N at the front edge to lift from 3.5 to 12 deg, 5 N m opening above 15 deg. Hook and lever one rigid part on a sprung pivot; it holds the hood only by contact with the striker bar.
